title: Tech Note: Server Process Activity Component
author: Kristopher Merolla, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Get process activity, introduced in 4D v16 R4, is still a supported and useful command for building custom server monitoring dashboards, so the core technique remains valid. The component's specific UI (classic listbox forms) and JSON/text logging approach are dated in style but functionally still workable; 4D's built-in server administration tools have also continued to improve since, somewhat reducing the need for a fully custom monitor.
related_updates: Get process activity remains part of the 4D language today
4D Server's built-in monitoring UI and tools have been enhanced in subsequent releases
Workers and preemptive process concepts introduced around this era remain current
